inventory.catalog_gap_entry_method: Sum all .records[].gaps[] entries from a fresh npm run --silent data:gaps report.
inventory.selection_note: Next high-priority evidence-found fields across distinct exact targets after excluding models audited in B108-B124 and their immediately adjacent models.

scope.research_boundary: Evidence-only Luna Max review. Inspect only these exact records, the listed attempt histories and accepted sources first. Work one exact model/source at a time. Recheck current sources only where needed; return direct URLs, actual access dates, source class, exact supported claims, conflicts, market/build caveats, and recommended resolution or evidence-backed open reason. Do not edit files. Primary writer integrates supported results.
excluded: No fields outside the ten frozen targets.
Do not reopen B108-B124 targets or immediately adjacent models.
Do not transfer values across model year, trim, market, size or product type.
No third-party image hosting or rights assumptions.
No new XHS capture, login, challenge handling or bypass.
